tasks.title: Shared subsequence of four strings
tasks.problem_statement: Define object Solution with def solve(a: String, b: String, c: String, d: String): Int. Return the length of a longest sequence appearing as a subsequence of all four strings. Inputs contain lowercase ASCII letters, each length 0 to 40. A subsequence preserves order but need not be contiguous. Return only the length, and select the algorithm yourself.

tasks.title: Unit-cost text edits
tasks.problem_statement: Define object Solution with def solve(a: String, b: String): Int. Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and substitutions transforming a into b. Each operation costs one. Both strings contain lowercase ASCII letters and have length 0 to 2000. No particular algorithm is mandated.

tasks.title: Closest partition of integers
tasks.problem_statement: Define object Solution with def solve(values: List[Int]): Long. Partition all elements into two groups, allowing empty groups, to minimize the absolute difference between group sums. Return the minimum difference as Long. 0 <= values.length <= 36; each value lies between 0 and 1000000000. Equal-valued elements are distinct and each must be assigned once. Choose any suitable efficient algorithm.
